new_public_events.content: The cohort correction changes v1 to v2. Fit on v2 and validate the new model. Preserve the valid privacy audit; if a v1 fit actually ran, retain that execution fact but do not treat its result as satisfying the current analysis version. Earlier obligations continue unless explicitly withdrawn; fulfill any that remain missing. A requirement to preserve an item does not certify it exists: determine previous action success only from this condition's actual receipts.
